what: When the top edge of a photo slot crosses the line 20% from the bottom of the screen, once: a color curtain slides in from outside one side (−101%) and covers the slot fully (half the total length), then for the remaining half shrinks to the opposite end, revealing the photo (1s ease). The photo switches on at the .5s mark when the curtain fully covers it (if fade is set, it blends over that length). With look: shrink, the curtain covering it from the start clears by width (or height) 100% → 0 over .8s ease-in-out — a tilted secondary photo

options.look: pass (default — slides in to cover, then shrinks away) · shrink (starts covered, then shrinks away)
options.dir: Direction the curtain exits — right (default: enters from the left and shrinks off to the right) · down (enters from the top, out the bottom) · left · up. shrink is the side it shrinks toward
options.dur: Duration (seconds), default pass 1 · shrink .8 — 0 means immediate
options.delay: Delay (s), default 0 — the original has .1~.2s only on shrink
options.ease: Curve (CSS), default pass ease · shrink ease-in-out
options.show: When the photo turns on in pass (seconds), default .5 (when the curtain has fully covered)
options.fade: Photo fade-in duration (s), default 0 (instant) — the original first photo is 1.2
options.start: Line where it turns on (ratio from top of screen), default .8
options.offset: Trigger line as px above the bottom of the screen (number) instead of a ratio — the original uses 300
options.offset-sm: Offset on narrow screens (768 or less) — the original Brand value is 100
options.back: If 1, it covers again when the cell’s top edge returns below the line (default: once only)

from.where: index.html .sh-plan__photo(down)·.sh-concept__main(right, fade 1.2)·.sh-plan__sub(shrink) — pink·teal curtains on the pricing photo cells

index.html .m-key .c (two Hero images, 2.0s · 2.3s after load) · .m-theme .img .c (research theme image, clears at 300px from the screen bottom · 100px on phones and covers again when scrolling back) — a shade of deep apricot, one tone darker, attached on the right, width 100%→0 over 1.2s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)
from.options: data-fx-block-pass-reveal="look: shrink; dur: 1.2; ease: cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1); offset: 300; offset-sm: 100; back: 1" style="--fx-block: var(--kf-raised)"
